text:
Janelle: Quick status update for Orch-lite (Helio Labs) private rollout — are we green on VPC egress, registry sync, and airgap artifacts? asking for a cutover window.
Ashwin: Network: staging firewall rules for 10.4.0.0/16 -> 52.23.11.0/24 are in, prod change needs SecOps thumbs up. NAT still pending.
Samir: SecOps gave a conditional OK (need NAT + tagging + audit log). Who will own NAT creation? @Maria?
Maria: I can create NAT in staging today. For prod we need infra ticket (INF-5482) — just created it and linked the IAM policy and tagging requirements.
Janelle: Thanks. Two quick blockers from the customer side: (1) offline registry sync — they require key rotation docs for airgap buckets; (2) control-plane certs — they need the intermediate CA + CRL bundled.
Ashwin: For certs we have offline CA artifacts but not the CRL metadata in the bundle. @Samir can you confirm we'll include the CRL and the rotation notes?
Samir: Confirmed — I'll put the intermediate CA, CRL, and rotation manifest into the airgap bundle. ETA EOD. Will add a small README with steps.
Janelle: Also, I filed a small config change to the private template to loosen kube-proxy egress for the proxy sidecar, please review: 
```diff
-    - --egress=10.0.0.0/8
+    - --egress=10.0.0.0/8,52.23.11.0/24
```
Ashwin: Reviewing the CR now. Quick note: ensure we keep iptables MASQ rules in place when adding the range.
devex-bot: Reminder: run the private-deploy smoke tests after merge: `./scripts/run-smoke --env=airgap --focus=egress`
Maria: Customer also requested static IPs for webhook callbacks. We can provide a small pool of Elastic IPs from the dedicated block, but need billing signoff for reserved IPs.
Janelle: Action items recap: (1) @Ashwin review CR and merge if OK (target 18:30 PT), (2) @Samir drop CA + CRL + README into airgap bundle by EOD, (3) @Maria create prod NAT ticket + add billing note for static IPs, (4) devex run smoke after merge. I'll post final cutover window after we close these. :thumbsup:
Ashwin: On it, ping me when CR is pushed.
Samir: I'll upload artifacts to S3 staging bucket and flagops for transfer to airgap repo. ops-bot please schedule the transfer job.
ops-bot: Scheduled transfer job to run at 23:45 UTC. Will post status in this thread when complete. :white_check_mark:
Janelle: Great — thanks everyone. If anything slips, call out here and we can move the window.
